name: DNZHRecomp
description:
Duke Nukem: Zero Hour Recompiled is a native PC port of the 1999 Nintendo 64 third-person shooter Duke Nukem: Zero Hour. Statically recompiled from original machine instructions, it runs natively on modern PC platforms without emulation latency.

Features:
- Native PC rendering delivering fluid high framerates and zero emulation stutter
- True widescreen and high-resolution monitor support
- Dual analog gamepad and mouse-look control configurations
- Preserved time-traveling campaign, authentic weapon arsenal, and voice lines
- Low-latency sound rendering with modern multi-channel audio support
